# Milan Kacar

> AI Engineer, Data Engineer, and Software Engineer based in Vienna, Austria.

## About

Milan Kacar is an AI and software engineer with experience spanning artificial intelligence, machine learning, large language models, data engineering, analytics, backend development, and research.

He has an academic background in geodesy and geomatics engineering from Graz University of Technology (TU Graz), with additional studies in computer science.

## Current Focus

* Artificial intelligence and machine learning
* Large language models (LLMs)
* AI agents and RAG systems
* Data engineering and data platforms
* AI-powered applications
* Machine learning infrastructure and MLOps
* Analytics and business intelligence
* Software architecture and backend systems

## Selected Projects

### AI SQL Analyst

An AI-powered data agent that converts natural-language questions into SQL queries, with safety mechanisms and data visualization.

Technologies: Python, LangGraph, React, SQLite, TypeScript.

### AI-Powered Chat Application

A real-time AI chat application using large language models, RAG, and custom model integrations.

Technologies: React, Python, Docker, OpenAI, Gemini.

### Robust Solar Panel Detection

Research project using computer vision and satellite imagery to detect solar panels and monitor solar adoption.

Technologies: Python, YOLOv5, CUDA, AWS/GCP.

### Global Scale Data Platforms

Data infrastructure supporting international markets, business dashboards, analytics, and machine-learning pipelines.

Technologies: GCP, AWS, BigQuery, DataProc, Vertex AI.

### FlowState: Gamified Recruitment

A recruitment application combining AI-assisted candidate evaluation with a high-velocity user interface.

Technologies: React Native, FastAPI, OpenAI, Redis, TypeScript.

### LLM Tokenizer Playground

Interactive educational software demonstrating Byte Pair Encoding and the mechanics of LLM tokenization.

Technologies: Rust, React, Axum, TypeScript.

### Looker Visualization — Period-over-Period

A Looker visualization plugin for period-over-period analytics without additional queries or compute.

Technologies: JavaScript, Looker, BI.

## Research

Milan Kacar has worked on applied machine learning and computer vision research, including detection of photovoltaic panels from satellite imagery and methods for improving robustness under distribution shifts.
